Dear openwashdata community,

Welcome to the September 2025 edition of our newsletter! This month, we dive 
into the fascinating demographics of our Data Science for openwashdata course 
participants and share important updates about the upcoming cohort.

## 📊 Blog Highlight: Who's Learning Data Science for WASH?

Our latest blog post analyzes registration data from the Data Science for 
openwashdata (ds4owd) course, revealing a truly global and diverse community 
of learners. The analysis shows:

- **Global reach**: Strong representation from African countries with 
  participants spanning multiple continents
- **Diverse backgrounds**: 40% of participants hold advanced degrees 
  (master's or doctorate), while 40% are employed full-time
- **Gender balance**: Approximately 40% female participation
- **Learning journey**: About 40% are R programming beginners, showing the 
  course's accessibility
- **AI adoption**: Interestingly, 40% already use AI platforms like ChatGPT 
  and Claude in their work

The blog post features beautiful visualizations including a world map of 
registrations, an age/gender population pyramid, and distributions of 
education levels and programming experience.

[Read the full analysis here](https://openwashdata.org/pages/blog/posts/2025-09-01-ds4owd-002-registration-analysis/)

## 🎓 Course Update: Registrations Still Open!

The second cohort of Data Science for openwashdata (ds4owd-002) starts next 
week on **Thursday, September 11th**. If you haven't registered yet, there's 
still time!

Can't make it to the live sessions? No problem! We've already held a 
pre-course Q&A session, and the recording along with comprehensive notes is 
available for all registered participants.

[Access Q&A recording and notes](https://ds4owd-002.github.io/website/modules/md-00.html)

The course covers:
- R programming fundamentals
- Data wrangling and visualization
- Working with WASH datasets
- Creating reproducible research
- Publishing data packages

Whether you're new to programming or looking to enhance your data science 
skills for WASH applications, this course provides a supportive learning 
environment with practical, hands-on exercises.

## Get Involved

We believe the openwashdata project prospers when we have **YOU** work
together and promote open science and data practice! Here's how you can
get involved:

- **Connect**: [Join our
  chatroom](https://openwashdata.org/pages/get-started/chat/) | [Matrix
  collaboration](https://matrix.to/#/%23openwashdata-lobby:staffchat.ethz.ch)
- **Share data**: [Submit your WASH
  dataset](https://openwashdata.org/pages/blog/posts/2024-05-17-data-publication-1/)
  | [Data dictionary
  template](https://github.com/openwashdata/data-dictionary-template)
- **Use & cite**: Find citation info on each dataset page | [Cite the

- **Contribute**: [Report issues or suggest
  ideas](https://github.com/openwashdata/openwashdata.github.io/issues)

- **Spread the word**: Forward this newsletter | Share on social media
